dedupeText: desolate landscape album cover monochrome halftone desolate silhouette landscape 80s aesthetic minimalist high contrast foreground silhouette vs distant horizon line dense halftone texture vs smooth white borders geometric sans serif header vs expressive script footer organic tree forms vs structured human profile combine a grainy high contrast monochrome landscape photo with a sandwich layout of white borders using a heavy extended sans serif for the top and a textured brush script for the bottom

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black and white landscape featuring a silhouetted male figure in the foreground looking toward a horizon with sparse, leafless trees under a bright, hazy sky. The composition is framed by thick white borders at the top and bottom containing distinct typographic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground silhouette vs. distant horizon line
Dense halftone texture vs. smooth white borders
Geometric sans-serif header vs. expressive script footer
Organic tree forms vs. structured human profile
coreInvariants: Monochromatic grayscale palette with a single muted accent color in the script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male profile in the lower-left foreground, scaled to approximately one-third of the image height; leafless trees positioned on the right third of the horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the figure's head and shoulders provides the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold top-left header, moves down to the figure, follows his gaze across the field to the trees, and ends at the script in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the top and bottom margins; large open sky area within the photographic frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white for borders and sky highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for silhouettes and halftone shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted, desaturated burgundy or dusty rose for the script text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white; low saturation throughout.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended geometric sans-serif and expressive brush script
letterConstructionRules: Header: Heavy weight, wide proportions, tight letter spacing.
Footer: Slanted, gestural, varying stroke thickness, dry-brush texture.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between rigid, industrial geometry and fluid, organic handwriting.

preserve: Extended width of the top font
Hand-painted feel of the bottom font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, wide, geometric structure of the header.
Captures the 80s-style casual brushwork of the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of a man's profile in the lower left, looking across a barren field toward three leafless trees on the right horizon. The sky should be bright and hazy. Apply a visible halftone dot or film grain texture. Place this image in a central horizontal band with thick white margins above and below.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top white margin, left-align a bold, extended geometric sans-serif title in gray. In the bottom white margin, right-align a gestural brush script subtitle in a muted rose color.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white with halftone texture?
Are the top and bottom margins pure white?
Is the header font significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the footer text in a contrasting script style?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the rose accent color
Number of trees on the horizon
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title text
Compact Disc logo in the bottom left corner

mustAchieve: Typographic contrast between industrial and organic

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the silhouette has sharp edges against the field
Verify the script text has a 'dry brush' texture
Confirm the top font is properly extended and bold
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy, high-contrast monochrome landscape photo with a 'sandwich' layout of white borders, using a heavy extended sans-serif for the top and a textured brush script for the bottom.
